title: ENKI Audit Event Instance
description: Schema for ENKI audit event instance objects

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this audit event instance

event_type.description: Event type ID from audit vocabulary (e.g., 'assertion.proposed', 'pack.loaded')

severity.description: Event severity level from audit vocabulary

actor_id.description: Identity of actor that triggered the event (optional)

assertion_id.description: Assertion being referenced by the event (optional)

target_id.description: Identifier of the target being operated on (optional)

target_type.description: Type of target being operated on (optional)

source.description: Source or origin of the event (optional)

errors.description: List of error details for failure events (optional)
